FR-001.title: The application MUST offer a point-of-sale destination in the existing navigation, gated on permission to use the point of sale, and MUST render it inside the existing application shell rather than as a separate full-screen surface.

FR-002.title: Entering the screen without a sale in progress MUST open a new sale record immediately, associated with the cashier's point of sale and facility, before any product is captured.

FR-003.title: The screen MUST NOT duplicate chrome the shell already provides — no second hamburger, no second back affordance, no simulated window frame — and MUST use the shell's own navigation controls.

FR-004.title: The screen's header, immediately below the shell's app bar, MUST carry the open-sales selector and the step indicator, and the step indicator MUST show which of the two or three steps is current, which are complete, and which are still ahead.

FR-005.title: The step indicator MUST present the steps in the order capture, payment, delivery — two steps when the fulfilment mode is counter pickup and three when it is delivery or mixed — and MUST update the moment the mode changes.

FR-006.title: A cashier without permission to open a sale at the point of sale MUST NOT be able to start one, and MUST be told why rather than shown a broken screen. Capturing lines is separately gated on permission to modify sales orders; the screen MUST refuse each action against its own permission.

FR-007.title: Every capture action — adding a line, changing a line's quantity, price, discount or warehouse, removing a line, changing the customer, the fulfilment mode, the payment terms or the currency — MUST be recorded on the server as it happens, not deferred to a later submit.

FR-008.title: After each recorded action, the screen MUST show the totals the server returns rather than totals it computed locally, so that displayed subtotal, discount, tax and grand total always match what the sale is worth.

FR-009.title: A capture action that the server rejects MUST leave the screen showing the last accepted state, name the reason, and be retryable without re-entering the rest of the sale.

FR-010.title: While a capture action is in flight, the screen MUST remain usable for reading, and MUST NOT lose keystrokes typed into the product search.

FR-011.title: The sale MUST open with the configured default walk-in customer preselected, and the customer area MUST show the customer's name, credit line, outstanding balance and price list.

FR-012.title: The cashier MUST be able to search for and select a different customer by code or name, and the selection MUST be recorded on the sale.

FR-013.title: The cashier MUST be able to create a customer from the sale without leaving it, capturing at minimum code, name, price list, zone, credit limit, credit days, tax registration, whether the customer may receive deliveries and whether deliveries need a signed document.

FR-014.title: A customer created from the sale MUST be attached to the sale on save, and the customer's price list MUST apply to lines added afterwards.

FR-015.title: When the customer changes on a sale that already has lines, every existing line MUST be re-priced against the new customer's price list, and the screen MUST reflect the updated prices and totals as any other server-driven change — no separate notice is needed. Requires backend change D-005 (mbe-api#131).

FR-016.title: The cashier MUST be able to choose immediate or credit payment terms; choosing credit for a customer without an available credit line MUST be refused with the reason shown.

FR-017.title: The screen MUST offer exactly three fulfilment modes — counter pickup, delivery, and mixed — as a single always-visible selector, defaulting to counter pickup.

FR-018.title: Selecting delivery or mixed MUST add a delivery step after the payment step; selecting counter pickup MUST remove it. The mode MUST be changeable freely while the sale is unconfirmed and MUST be fixed once the sale is confirmed.

FR-019.title: Delivery and mixed modes MUST be unavailable for a customer not permitted to receive deliveries, with the reason shown.

FR-020.title: The screen MUST provide one input that both accepts a scanned barcode and searches by code, name, brand or SKU, and MUST keep focus in it after each successful add so consecutive scans need no clicks.

FR-021.title: A scan that matches exactly one product MUST add that product directly; a search that matches several MUST present the matches with code, name, brand, price and per-warehouse availability for the cashier to choose.

FR-022.title: Each line MUST show the product name and code, the source warehouse, that warehouse's availability for the product, quantity, unit, unit price, discount, tax rate, and the line total.

FR-023.title: Each line's quantity, unit price, discount rate, tax rate and source warehouse MUST be editable in place, and quantity MUST additionally be adjustable by increment and decrement controls.

FR-024.title: Adding a product MUST default its source warehouse to the warehouse configured for the cashier's point of sale, and the cashier MUST be able to change it per line and see availability for the chosen warehouse.

FR-025.title: A line whose ordered quantity exceeds availability in its chosen warehouse MUST carry a visible, non-blocking warning stating the shortfall, and MUST offer to reduce the quantity to what is available.

FR-026.title: A line for a product with no availability in its chosen warehouse MUST be distinguished from a partial shortfall and MUST offer a way to look at other warehouses.

FR-027.title: The cashier MUST be able to remove a line, and removal MUST take effect immediately with no confirmation prompt for a line that has just been added.

FR-028.title: A summary MUST stay visible at all times showing line count, total units, subtotal, total discount, tax and grand total in the sale's currency.

FR-029.title: The delivery step MUST open after the sale is paid, and only for sales in delivery or mixed mode. It MUST list every destination as a card carrying its address, contact name and phone, delivery date, its line count and its unit count, and MUST allow adding, editing and removing destinations.

FR-030.title: A destination MUST be recorded as a delivery against the sale as soon as its address is chosen, and each subsequent change to it — contact, date, or any line quantity — MUST be recorded as it is made, consistent with FR-007. Nothing on this step may be held unrecorded until the sale closes.

FR-031.title: Adding a destination MUST let the cashier pick one of the customer's existing addresses or create a new address inline, without leaving the step or losing the distribution already entered.

FR-032.title: Each destination MUST allow a per-line quantity to be set, and MUST refuse a quantity that would take a line beyond what remains undistributed across all destinations.

FR-033.title: The step MUST show, for every line, the ordered quantity and how it is distributed across destinations and the counter, and MUST show a running count of distributed units against total units.

FR-034.title: The first destination MUST be pre-filled from the sale's main delivery address (FR-056), and the cashier MUST be able to change it.

FR-035.title: In mixed mode, quantity left undistributed MUST be presented as staying at the counter for pickup and MUST NOT block closing the sale; in delivery mode, any undistributed quantity MUST block closing and the block MUST name how many units of which lines are unassigned.

FR-036.title: Closing a mixed-mode sale MUST record the undistributed remainder as a counter-pickup delivery, so that every ordered unit is accounted for by exactly one delivery record.

FR-037.title: A destination the system refuses to record MUST leave the rest of the step untouched: the reason is shown, the entered values are kept, and the cashier can retry that destination alone.

FR-038.title: Continuing from the capture step to the payment step MUST confirm the sale, and confirmation MUST be blocked while the sale has no lines.

FR-039.title: A confirmation rejected for insufficient stock or zero-priced lines MUST leave the cashier on the capture step with the offending lines identified, and the sale still editable.

FR-040.title: After confirmation the sale's reference MUST switch from its provisional identifier to the assigned folio wherever it is displayed.

FR-041.title: After confirmation, the lines, the customer, the payment terms and the fulfilment mode MUST become read-only, and the screen MUST say so rather than offering controls that will fail.

FR-042.title: The payment step MUST show the sale's total, the amount already paid, and the outstanding balance at all times.

FR-043.title: The cashier MUST be able to enter a payment amount by keyboard and by an on-screen number pad, and MUST be offered quick amounts including the full outstanding balance.

FR-044.title: The cashier MUST select a payment method for each payment from the methods the system supports, and each method MUST state whether it needs a reference or authorization.

FR-045.title: A payment whose method requires a reference MUST NOT be recordable until the reference is entered.

FR-046.title: Adding a payment MUST record it against the sale immediately and reduce the outstanding balance by the applied amount.

FR-047.title: A tender larger than the outstanding balance MUST apply only the outstanding amount and present the difference as change due.

FR-048.title: Applied payments MUST be listed with method, amount, reference and any pending-validation state, and each MUST be reversible while the sale is unconfirmed as paid, with the reversal reason recorded.

FR-049.title: The action that leaves the payment step MUST be unavailable while the outstanding balance is above zero, and MUST state the condition that unlocks it.

FR-050.title: Leaving the payment step MUST show the change due, then end the workflow and offer to start a new sale for a counter-pickup sale, or open the delivery step for a delivery or mixed sale.

FR-051.title: A sale on credit terms MUST be able to leave the payment step with an outstanding balance, and the screen MUST make clear that the remainder is owed rather than unpaid in error.

FR-052.title: The screen MUST use the application's existing theme, typography and iconography — the mock's palette is reference only — and MUST honour the established conventions for filters, pickers, forms and error banners.

FR-053.title: The screen MUST be usable from 1440 px down to 360 px without horizontal scrolling at any width, collapsing the line grid to a single-column list and the step indicator to a step-of-total label below 600 px.

FR-054.title: All screen text MUST come from the application's localization resources in both supported languages, with no literal strings in the screen itself.

FR-055.title: Money and quantities MUST be formatted for the active locale, and the sale's currency MUST be shown wherever a total is presented.

FR-056.title: Selecting delivery or mixed MUST require the cashier to name the sale's main delivery address before capture continues, choosing one of the customer's addresses or creating one inline, and that address MUST be recorded on the sale.

FR-057.title: The fulfilment mode MUST survive leaving and reopening the screen: a resumed sale MUST reopen in the mode it was captured in, determined from what the sale itself records rather than from anything held in the screen.

FR-058.title: A sale in delivery or mixed mode MUST NOT be presented as finished while units remain undistributed, and such a sale MUST remain reachable from the open-sales selector until its delivery is complete.

FR-002a.title: A sale MUST NOT be opened while the cashier has no current cash session (neither open nor stale). The screen MUST instead explain that a shift must be opened first and offer a way into the cash session screen.

FR-002b.title: A stale cash session (open, but started on an earlier day) MUST NOT block opening a sale. The screen MUST show a non-blocking indication that the session predates today.

context: area: mbe-api sales_orders, delivery_orders, customer_payments, customers, addresses endpoints and services
area: mbe-ui app shell, router, nav destinations, catalog pickers and address inline create
constraint: a delivery record requires a confirmed sales order; confirming freezes the sale
constraint: a payment can only be applied to a confirmed, uncancelled sales order
constraint: line prices resolve from the customer price list at add time and are not repriced later
decision: live recording — order opened on entry, lines posted as captured, confirm on Continuar al cobro
decision: runs inside the existing nav shell; open-orders selector and stepper live in the app bar

decision (late change): step order is Venta → Cobro → Entrega; delivery runs last, against a confirmed and paid sale, so destinations record live and the confirmed-sale precondition is satisfied by construction
consequence: fulfilment mode must be durable on the sale itself (main delivery address captured in step 1) so a reopened sale knows whether a delivery step is owed
analysis: /speckit-analyze (2026-08-04) found 2 CRITICAL, 3 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM/LOW findings across spec/plan/tasks — all remediated same session
decision: payment application must refresh Sale via PosSaleController.refresh() (analysis I1) or the payment-step close gate never unlocks
decision: open-sales selector must query status=paid too, not just draft/completed (analysis C1), or FR-058's paid-undistributed sale is unreachable

decision (post-analysis): FR-015 redesigned around reprice-on-customer-change per mbe-api team confirmation of legacy behavior; current mbe-api does not reprice (verified in update_order source) — filed mbe-api#131 as a BLOCKING dependency (D-005)

resolved 2026-08-05: all 8 filed mbe-api issues (#131-138) shipped in PR #139, verified against source + regenerated client — create-then-trim delivery split, comment-encoded contact, session-scoped payments, read-only tax rate all removed as stopgaps

new dependency 2026-08-05: spec 021 (cash sessions) shipped in lib/features/sales/ (the module this feature already targeted) — reused directly: decimal dep, money.dart, MoneyFormatters, PaymentMethod enum, currentSessionControllerProvider
decision 2026-08-05: cash session is now a hard precondition for opening a sale (FR-002a/b), reversing 021's own recorded D-002 'no coupling' decision by explicit product direction — spec.md D-006
decision 2026-08-05: POS route/open-a-sale RBAC corrected from salesOrders to pos (44), matching legacy's 'POS module' privilege and 021's own precedent
intent: Give cashiers a point-of-sale screen that records the sale live and adapts between a two-step counter flow and a three-step delivery flow, ending in payment.
expectations: No returns, refunds, credit notes or cancelling a confirmed sale
No delivery routing, itineraries or proof of delivery
No card terminal integration or payment verification
